about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Craftsmanship meets design - comfort and style for every home since 2006.
about.body: Welcome to "EKOPROF" LLC, where craftsmanship meets design, creating the essence of comfort and style for every home. Founded in 2006, we've dedicated ourselves to plastic decoration making, blending traditional techniques with modern aesthetics. Our journey began in Yerevan, inspired by a passion for exceptional design and a vision to make quality products accessible to everyone. We believe that every product should add value to your home, which is why we pour our soul and passion into its production. At "EKOPROF", we are more than just a plastic production company; we are innovators and designers committed to sustainability and ethical manufacturing practices. Our materials are carefully selected for their quality, durability, and minimal environmental impact, ensuring that we not only create beautiful products but also protect the planet for future generations. Our company consists of skilled craftsmen, engineers and an engaged team who work hand-in-hand to bring our vision to life. From the initial sketch to the final product, every step is executed with precision and care, ensuring that each piece meets our high standards of quality and innovation. We understand that choosing home repair details is a deeply personal decision, which is why we offer customizable options to fit different tastes and spaces. Our goal is to help you equip a home that reflects your style and comfort. Thank you for choosing the "COMFORT" trademark. We are honored to be a part of your home and look forward to creating beautiful, lasting home details that you and your family will cherish for years to come.
